[[19 BBY]], on a [[Unidentified rocky planet (Inquisitors)|rocky planet]]According to "[[The Redemption of Barriss Offee]]," the [[Jedi]] [[Death|died]] in the immediate aftermath of "[[Realization]]," which is set on a [[Unidentified rocky planet (Inquisitors)|rocky planet]]. As established [[Template:TalesDate|here]], the events of "Realization" occur around [[19 BBY]]. |species=[[Human]]{{TOTE|Realization}} |gender= |pronouns=They/them |height= |mass= |hair=[[Color|Brown]] |feathers= |eyes=Brown |skin=Dark |cyber= |families= |parents= |partners= |siblings= |children= |affiliation=*[[Jedi Order]] *A [[Unidentified rebel cell|rebel cell]] |masters= |apprentices= }} {{Quote|Aren't you tired of running?''"
"''I'm so tired. And I feel so alone.|Barriss Offee and the Jedi|}} A [[human]] '''Jedi''' survived the [[Great Jedi Purge|destruction]] of the [[Jedi Order]] and the [[Proclamation of the New Order|rise]] of the [[Galactic Empire]]. They went into hiding on a [[Unidentified rocky planet (Inquisitors)|rocky planet]], working alongside a local [[Unidentified rebel cell|rebel cell]]. The [[Fourth Sister]] and [[Barriss Offee]], Imperial [[Inquisitor]]s, were [[Mission to a rocky planet|dispatched]] to [[Death|eliminate]] the [[Jedi]]. After the pair located them, the Jedi [[Lightsaber duel|dueled]] the Inquisitors, eventually being convinced to surrender by Offee. The Fourth Sister struck them down regardless, leading Offee, who had discovered the human still lived and wished to help them, to turn against her fellow Inquisitor before returning to save the Jedi, who [[Death|died]] shortly thereafter. ==Biography== ===The lone Jedi=== {{Quote|Our target is known to be working with a local rebel cell, so don't let your guard down.''"
"''From the intel, it seems unclear whether a Jedi is involved or not.|The Fourth Sister and Barriss Offee|}} [[File:RockyPlanetSettlement-Realization.png|thumb|left|300px|The Jedi worked with a rebel cell based in this remote settlement.]] A [[human]] served as a [[Jedi]] of the [[Jedi Order]] in the final [[Republic Era|days]] of the [[Galactic Republic]]. In [[19 BBY]], [[Supreme Chancellor]] Palpatine, secretly the [[Sith Lord]] [[Darth Sidious]], [[Proclamation of the New Order|transformed]] the Republic into the [[Galactic Empire]], [[Order 66|ordering]] the [[Great Jedi Purge|destruction]] of the Jedi Order and for all survivors to be [[Hunting|hunted]] down.''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' The human Jedi survived the fall of the Order, and they eventually went into hiding on a [[Unidentified rocky planet (Inquisitors)|rocky planet]].{{TOTE|Realization}} {{AD|Disney+}} On the [[planet]], they worked alongside a local [[Unidentified rebel cell|rebel cell]] based in a [[Unidentified settlement (rocky planet)|settlement]] that refused to show loyalty to the Empire. However, intel regarding the Jedi's collaboration with the rebel cell reached the [[Inquisitorius]], [[Dark side of the Force|fallen]] Jedi who served the Empire as [[Jedi hunter]]s, and [[the Grand Inquisitor]] [[Mission to a rocky planet|dispatched]] two [[Inquisitor]]s, the [[Fourth Sister]] and [[Barriss Offee]], to [[Death|eliminate]] them. Offee believed the intel was unclear as to whether a Jedi was involved, while the settlement's [[Unidentified human governor|governor]] claimed there was no Jedi on the planet when the Inquisitors arrived to interrogate the populace. However, Offee learned from a [[Unidentified human girl (rocky planet)|young girl]] that the Jedi was hiding in the [[mountain]]s near the settlement, and the two Inquisitors set out to find them after the Fourth Sister slaughtered the [[governor]] and a number of civilians. [[File:LynJediDuel-Realization.png|thumb|right|300px|After they were discovered, the Jedi dueled the Empire's Inquisitors.]] A rockfall slowed Offee down as the two Inquisitors climbed the mountain, leading the Fourth Sister to encounter the Jedi on her own. The Jedi [[Lightsaber duel|dueled]] with the Fourth Sister, defending against the strikes of her [[Fourth Sister's hilt|blade]] with their own [[lightsaber]]. As the Jedi swung at the Fourth Sister, the Inquisitor leaped over them. However, the Jedi was able to barrel kick her to the ground. When they went to strike at the incapacitated Fourth Sister, Offee blocked with her [[Barriss Offee's double-bladed spinning lightsaber|lightsaber]]. ===A new chance=== {{Quote|I won't let you die. You're not alone.|Barriss Offee to the Jedi, after returning to save them|}} As Offee and the Jedi clashed, the Inquisitor ordered them to surrender. The Jedi stepped back, accusing Offee of treachery, before they continued the duel. They [[Force power|used]] [[the Force]] to [[Force push|push]] Offee toward the edge of the cliff, but the Inquisitor stopped herself with her blade. Offee evaded the human's next strikes and gave them a chance to surrender, telling them that they did not have to pay for the rest of the Jedi's hubris. The Jedi refused, but the Inquisitor deactivated her blade, offering them a chance for a new life if they turned themself in. [[File:JediBarriss-Realization.png|thumb|left|300px|Although Barriss Offe returned, she was unable to prevent the Jedi's death.]] When Offee sympathized with the Jedi, they admitted that they were tired and alone. Offee asked the human to join them, and they extinguished their lightsaber in surrender. However, the Fourth Sister struck the Jedi down from behind, to Offee's dismay. The Fourth Sister took the Jedi's lightsaber, but Offee knelt beside them, discovering they were still alive. Although Offee wished to take the Jedi to the Inquisitors' [[Scythe (Phi-class)|ship]] to save them, the Fourth Sister told her to let them die. The Fourth Sister's determination to eliminate the Jedi led Offee to turn on her, throwing her former partner off the cliff and renouncing her status as an Inquisitor. Offee returned to the Jedi and held them in her [[Limb|arms]], assuring them that she would not let them die and that they were no longer alone as they died. In the Jedi's final moments, Offee tended to them. After the Jedi's death, Offee abandoned the Empire and became a [[Force healing|Force healer]] to bring help to those in need.{{InsiderCite|229|The Redemption of Barriss Offee}} ==Personality and traits== {{Quote|You're a traitor and a murderer.''"
"''Not true.''"
"''You expect me to believe you?|The Jedi and Barriss Offee|}} [[File:BarrissVsRockyPlanetJedi-Realization.png|thumb|right|300px|The Jedi attempted to strike down the incapacitated Fourth Sister in anger.]] Although they felt alone and tired of running in the wake of the Jedi Order's destruction, the human remained determined to fight, initially refusing to stand down when Offee ordered them to. The Jedi refused to believe Offee's claim that their accusations against her were untrue. However, after Offee appealed to the Jedi and offered them mercy if they joined her, they surrendered to the Inquisitor. When Offee returned to rescue them after turning against the Fourth Sister, the Jedi was uncertain, but nodded when Offee told them they were not alone. The human had [[Color|brown]] [[hair]], brown [[eye]]s, and dark skin. ==Powers and abilities== [[File:JediSaber-Realization.png|thumb|left|300px|Despite the Jedi's hardships, they were determined to stand against the Inquisitors.]] As a member of the Jedi Order, the human was [[Force-sensitive]] and was [[Jedi training|trained]] to wield the Force. They were able to defend themself in lightsaber combat against the Fourth Sister, and later Offee, for some time, as well as use telekinesis. ==Equipment== The Jedi wielded a blue-bladed lightsaber, which was taken by the Fourth Sister after she struck them down. While in hiding on the rocky planet, the human [[Clothing|wore]] a blue tunic with white sleeves, dark pants, and brown [[boot]]s. They wore their hair tied back with a brown band. ==Behind the scenes== The Jedi appeared, albeit unnamed, in the ''[[Star Wars: Tales of the Empire]]'' episode "[[Realization]]," released on [[May 4]], [[2024]].{{SW|url=news/tales-of-the-empire-trailer|text=''Star Wars: Tales of the Empire'' Trailer Revealed}} They were voiced by [[Ry Chase]] and credited as "The Jedi." ==Appearances== *{{TOTE|Realization}} {{1st}} ==Sources== *{{InsiderCite|229|The Redemption of Barriss Offee}} *{{InsiderCite|236|Tales of Destiny}} ==Notes and references== {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of unidentified human Jedi}} {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |es=Jedi humana no identificada |ka=უცნობი ადამიანი ჯედაი }} [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified gender]] [[Category:Individuals with they/them pronouns]] [[Category:Jedi Purge victims]]
